name: Adjustable Sensor Bracket
description: Right-angle sensor bracket, 40 x 30 mm base with a 50 mm upright: two vertical adjustment slots in the face and two M4 base holes.

steps.instruction: Create the base plate: 40 mm long (X, from X=0 to X=40), 30 mm wide (Y, centered) and 4 mm thick (Z), base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the base plate: 40 mm long (X, from X=0 to X=40), 30 mm wide (Y, centered) and 4 mm thick (Z), base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the bracket's 40 x 30 x 4 mm foot plate, running along +X from the origin.

steps.instruction: Add the upright: a plate 4 mm thick (X, from X=0 to X=4), 30 mm wide (Y, centered) and 50 mm tall (Z, from Z=0), fused with the base at the corner.

transcript.user_prompt: Add the upright: a plate 4 mm thick (X, from X=0 to X=4), 30 mm wide (Y, centered) and 50 mm tall (Z, from Z=0), fused with the base at the corner.
transcript.assistant_message: I raised the 50 mm sensor face plate at the back edge of the foot — the bracket's L-profile is complete.

steps.instruction: Cut two vertical adjustment slots through the upright along X: each slot is 4.2 mm wide (Y), 14 mm long overall in Z (a 9.8 mm straight section capped by radius-2.1 mm rounded ends), centered at Z=30, at Y = +/-8.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut two vertical adjustment slots through the upright along X: each slot is 4.2 mm wide (Y), 14 mm long overall in Z (a 9.8 mm straight section capped by radius-2.1 mm rounded ends), centered at Z=30, at Y = +/-8.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the two rounded adjustment slots through the sensor face — an M4 screw can slide 14 mm vertically in each before clamping.

steps.instruction: Drill two M4 clearance holes of radius 2.1 mm vertically through the base at X=28, Y = +/-8.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill two M4 clearance holes of radius 2.1 mm vertically through the base at X=28, Y = +/-8.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the two 4.2 mm mounting holes through the foot so the bracket bolts down with M4 screws.

steps.instruction: Chamfer the straight top edges of the upright (at Z=50) with a 1 mm chamfer.

transcript.user_prompt: Chamfer the straight top edges of the upright (at Z=50) with a 1 mm chamfer.
transcript.assistant_message: I chamfered the top of the sensor face 1 mm to finish the bracket.
